meta.orientation: every pair is [A, B] in backtest.json order (A = first ufcstats name); p_* = probability that A wins
meta.open: first line BFO lists for the fight (one book, often weeks out; may not have been bettable in size)
meta.close: consensus closing line: BFO mean of the books' closing decimal odds (last point of BFO's mean-odds series) when both fighter pages were read; else the mean of the per-book closes on the event page; else the decimal midpoint of the closing range (nlbair); else one book's close (Ultimate UFC Dataset)
meta.books: per-book closing lines from BFO event pages; covers only the US books BFO lists today (about 2021 on); Polymarket/Kalshi are listed when present but never enter the consensus
meta.walk_forward: closing lines are known only minutes before the fight; they are a benchmark and a stacking input for live use, never a feature of a model scored on the same fight before the line closes
sources: BestFightOdds.com (opening lines, closing ranges, mean-odds series, per-book closes), fetched by tools/market.py
nlbair/ufc-data v0.1.1 (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23458636): BFO opening line and closing range per ufcstats fight id
Ultimate UFC Dataset (mdabbert / shortlikeafox, CC BY 4.0): one closing moneyline per fighter
